node.name: McpzAtmosphereController
node.docstring:
Exterior fog / brightness (IsoCraft parity feature): a moody atmospheric fog for the isometric exterior, applied by {@code FogRendererMixin} only while the MCPZ camera is active. Purely presentation — it never touches gameplay state.

The fog color doubles as the exterior brightness control (a higher brightness lifts the fog/sky tone toward white). All parameters clamp through pure static helpers so the tunables are unit-testable without a renderer.

node.name: MinecraftItemRepresentationRegistry
node.docstring:
Maps stable MCPZ item definition IDs (data/content/items/tier-a.json) to their Minecraft representations (W3-ITEMS). Minecraft registered items are adapters for MCPZ domain items — ItemStack is never the gameplay truth. The table below mirrors tier-a.json deterministically; {@code ItemTableConsistencyTest} verifies it against the JSON so the two cannot drift silently.

Missing mappings throw a readable development error; there is no silent fallback to an unrelated vanilla item. {@link #registerMinecraftItems()} is common/server-safe (no client classes) and runs from the mod initializer.
